_doc: The lines a unit may add to a packet (G-RENDER, test/shiploop_e2e/render_diff.py --unit Un). One key per unit of the efficiency plan, so units that change packet text edit different lines of this file; the list stays empty for a unit that adds no line. An entry: {"prefix": the first characters of the added line (8 or more), "stages": [stage names or patterns, default all], "routes": [inline, ask-agent, default both], and exactly one of "offset": [prefixes of lines the same change removes from the same stage; the entry's added lines may not be longer in all than the removed lines it names] or "approval": the decision that allows the growth (the plan row, owner message or review)}. "note" is free text.

U12.note: the plan lists no focused ID, so the template prints an empty list in place of the example row (U12, plan row X-5)
a spec with no R-<n> says so and names the route, paid for by the removed example row (U12, plan row SPEC-3 d)

U12.approval: plan 3.2 row SPEC-3 (d) and U12 exit item 6: the head lists the spec's R-ids (60 characters of each entry; IDs alone above 2,400 characters)
U12.note: appears only when the spec holds an entry

U12.prefix: Focused IDs after the template's rows
U12.approval: U12: the template prints at most 12 skeleton rows; the other focused IDs are named in this line (plan row X-5 with the head bound of ADDENDUM-cut)
U12.note: appears only for a plan with more than 12 focused IDs

U12.approval: plan 3.2 row X-5: one skeleton row per focused-command ID, at most 12 rows (about 220 characters each)
U12.note: appears only when the step plan lists focused IDs; the offline walk lists none
